shortDescription: Framework for randomly generated "titan" creatures: XML-defined traits with hidden-until-seen discovery, material (stuffed) creatures like steel wolves, inheritance through breeding. Works on any pawn.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and, later, a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals and (phase 2) materials.

## Status
- **Phase 1 (tested in game, works):** traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- **Visuals:** overlays and effecters tested in game (runs #19-21, clean). Flame sprites and body-scaled effecters built (build 12), not yet tested.
- **Phase 2 (next):** material creatures.
- **Phase 3:** AI use of abilities by non-humanlikes, diet-changing traits, humanlike (Biotech) birth inheritance, hiding hidden traits from stat explanations, optional VRE gene compat once VRE releases.

## Why not genes / VRE
Animals have no gene tracker, most genes assume humanlike systems, and it would require Biotech. Vanilla Ranching Expanded (via VEF.AnimalGenes) was reviewed: animal-only, fixed genes per species, no hidden genes, needs VEF. Kept standalone; optional compat later.

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- **Generation:** `commonality`, `pointCost` (negative = drawback), `exclusionTags`, `tags` (convention: `Weakness` for exploitable flaws), race filters (`allowAnimals/Humanlikes/Mechanoids/Other`, `requiresFlesh`, `min/maxBodySize`, `allowedRaces`, `disallowedRaces`).
- **Discovery:** `visible`, `discoverWhen` (Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies; only when the player can see it), `discoveryMessage`.
- **Naming:** `namePrefix`, `nameSuffix`, `nameOrder`. Only discovered traits affect the name.
- **Inheritance:** `heritable`, `inheritChance` (per carrying parent, compounds).
- **Effects:** `stage`, `hediffs`, `abilities`, `traitClass`.
- **Visuals:** `overlays`, `flames`, `effecters`, `scaleEffectersWithBodySize` (default true), `showVisualsWhenHidden` (default false).

## Visuals
- **TitanOverlay:** redraws the body (and head for humanlikes) texture with a glow shader. `color` (alpha = strength), `scale`, `layer` (relative to body/head; default 1 = over), `alignBottom` + `feetDepth` (0.25: shift a scaled overlay up so it stays on the feet), `pulseSpeed`/`pulseMin` (game-time pulse, per-pawn phase; speeds up with game speed), `includeHead`, `shaderType` (default MoteGlow). Mirrors vanilla's animal alternate and female graphics. Additive glow is weak on dark creatures.
- **TitanFlames:** flickering fire sprites (default vanilla Things/Special/Fire frames) placed at stable per-creature points on the body. `count`, `size` (fraction of mesh height), `x`/`z` ranges (fractions of mesh from centre), `verticalFacingWidth`, `color`, `ticksPerFrame`, `layer`, `texFolder`. Drawn in the node's PostDraw from a null-material draw request so they follow movement, facing and animation. Skipped on portraits, statues and invisible pawns.
- Render nodes come from a DynamicPawnRenderNodeSetup subclass (vanilla picks it up; no Harmony). The tree is dirtied only when a trait with overlays/flames is added, removed or discovered.
- **Effecters:** ticked every tick by MapComponent_TitanVisuals; only titans with active effecters are tracked; paused while fogged or off-screen map; respawned every 600k ticks (sub-effecter lifespan). Spread and particle size scale with sqrt(body size), clamped 0.5-2.5.

## TitanTrait (instance, saved per creature)
Hooks: PostAdded, PreRemoved, PostDiscovered, TickInterval (only when overridden), Notify_PawnPostApplyDamage, Notify_PawnUsedVerb, Notify_PawnDied, TipStringExtra, ExposeData. `VisualsActive`. Don't add/remove traits from verb/damage/discovery hooks.

## Hediff_Titan (TF_Titan, one per titan)
Holds traits; merges stages into one cached stage. Refreshes needs and disabled work. Health tab "titan traits (2 known, 1 unknown)". Registered in a ConditionalWeakTable.

## TitanUtility (public API)
GetTitan, IsTitan, GetOrMakeTitan, CanAddTrait, AddTrait, RemoveTrait, ClearTitan, DiscoverAll, RollTraits, InheritTraits, PlayerCanObserve.

## Harmony patches
BestKindLabel postfix (names); DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer (parents); TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix (inheritance).

## Known limitations
- Info card stat breakdown shows hidden traits' numbers.
- Hidden traits' abilities may show as gizmos.
- Animals don't use abilities on their own yet.
- Humanlike births don't inherit yet.
- Humanlike body overlay uses the plain naked body path.
- Debug palette pins for our actions fail ("Could not find node from path"); don't pin them.

## Debug actions (category "Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples): remove or move before publishing
Flaming (visible; faint warm tint, 3 flame sprites, TF_Effecter_Embers with Biotech FireSpew_A licks via MayRequire, fire glow, sparks, smoke), Venomous (hidden; green tint on discovery), Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle.

## Phase 2 plan: materials (literal construct)
Material = StuffDef on the titan hediff, always in the name. Armor from stuff, attack damage from sharp/blunt multipliers, colour tint, butchering yields stuff, market value scales. No bleeding/pain/breathing/toxic/rot. Still eats, heals, breeds. Inherited from a parent.
